theorems.description: Uniqueness of identity element under natural monoid
theorems.code:
theorem grp_01_identity_uniqueness (a : Nat) : a + 0 = a := by
  omega

theorems.description: Right cancellation law for commutative monoids
theorems.code:
theorem grp_02_cancellation_law (a b c : Nat) (h : a + c = b + c) : a = b := by

theorems.description: Involutory scalar symmetry over endomorphism ring
theorems.code:
theorem grp_03_involution_fixed_point (x : Nat) : x + x = 2 * x := by
